title: ever SIENNA|3/4 Sleeve Sparkly Sequin Round Neck Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shine at any wedding with this 3/4 Sleeve Sparkly Sequin Round Neck Midi Wedding Guest Dress. The shimmering sequin design adds a dazzling touch, while the classic round neckline and 3/4 sleeves create a sophisticated silhouette. The midi length ensures elegance and ease of movement, making it perfect for formal celebrations or evening events.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: 3/4 sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
